name: Camp Wawenock
description_short: All-girls overnight camp in Raymond, Maine. It offers a 7-week full season, two half seasons, and shorter introductory programs for younger girls (Wayseeker, 2 weeks, and Wonder Week, 1 week).
activities: Senior overnight trips (camping, rafting, rock climbing, biking, hiking, sea kayaking)
refund_policy_summary: You can get the tuition deposit back if you cancel by February 1. Tuition is not reduced if a camper arrives late or leaves early, except for illness. In that case the family and the camp each cover half the loss.
swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront is one of the program areas. Red Cross Lifeguard Training is an optional $250 add-on for Full Season campers who are 15 or older and have passed the Red Cross prerequisites. Space is limited.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Summer Camp Dates & Rates | Camp Wawenock Maine

warnings: The early registration rate ($13,200 for Full Season, $9,200 for Half Season) ends October 15, 2026, two days after today. The listed prices are the regular rates.
Payment schedule: $2,000 deposit (Wonder Week $1,500), a February payment, and the balance in May.
Optional extra costs: horseback riding ($575/$775 for the full season, $275/$375 for a half season), golf ($250), lifeguard training ($250), Senior trips ($225), and the required uniform.
Grade ranges vary by session: Full Season is entering 3rd-10th, Half Season entering 3rd-9th, Wayseeker entering 2nd-4th, and Wonder Week entering 2nd-3rd.
unknowns: Overall camper age range (the page gives grades; ages are stated only for the half season, 8-14)
